definition_change_before_freeze: The first oracle run labelled any configuration ending in releaseRuntimeClasspath as shipped; benchmark and non-minified variants were excluded before freezing and before any APSA scan. Raw Gradle lockfiles are unchanged.
shipped_definition: Configurations of :app named <flavor>ReleaseRuntimeClasspath, releaseRuntimeClasspath or runtimeClasspath, excluding benchmark and non-minified baseline-profile variants. Derived from Gradle's own lockfiles written by `gradle :app:dependencies --write-locks` with every configuration locked.
